body: Wouldn't that rather be a 2.x issue, as well? Since the inflector is completely merged from 2.x to 3.x at this point.
Why are you pluralizing an already plural word?
Inflector::pluralize() pretty much always fails on plural forms. This will not be fixed.

I detected the issue when I tried to run bake.
I get an error saying that Menuses table does not exist.
You might want to look into bake's conventions regarding this.
The problem is caused by `ModelTask` passing the table name which is already plural to `ConventionsTrait::_modelName()` which camelizes and pluralizes.

Sorry about that, should have given some context initially.
Running Inflector::pluralize(Inflector::singularize($string)) gives the desired result.
One small suggestion.
It might be a good idea to add some kind of shortcut function like Inflector::plural() that invokes these methods together.
@SplicePHP I don't think such a shortcut method makes sense.
@SplicePHP Singularizing a singular will also often not work.
@SplicePHP So how did you call bake originally?

I had the same problem.
My database table:

``` sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `menus` (
  `id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
```

After run `cake bake controller menus` I get a `MenusesController.php`
After run `cake bake model menus` I get an error message:

```
Exception: SQLSTATE[42S02]: Base table or view not found: 1146 Table 'xxx.menuses' doesn't exist in [...\vendor\cakephp\cakephp\src\Database\Schema\Collection.php, line 151]
```

I suspect it being related to https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/pull/4720 and tabelize() re-pluralizing the table here (which is already plural `menus`).
Maybe that command should also be "cake bake table ..."? For other model/repository type baking is probably not too relevant.

Bake's shell uses `_modelName()` method to parse table name:
https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/3.0/src/Core/ConventionsTrait.php#L53

So yes it seems to pluralizes an already plural word
From a `model = entity` perspective that would be correct, but since you are not baking that, but a table class I think the baking process should be revised as outlined earlier.
